paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: : Loss Ratio FLOPs
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the loss ratio as a function of FLOPs for several models. The x-axis, labeled “TFLOPS,” is a logarithmic scale, ranging from approximately 1e7 to 9e8, with tick intervals of 1e8. The y-axis, labeled “Loss Ratio (%),” extends from approximately 94% to 100%, with tick intervals of 1%. A solid, magenta line represents the loss ratio for Vanilla, initially at approximately 97.5% at 1e7 TFLOPS and declining to approximately 96.8% at 9e8 TFLOPS. A solid, orange line represents the loss ratio for SepLLM (n=64), starting at approximately 97.9% at 1e7 TFLOPS, decreasing to approximately 96.3% at 3e8 TFLOPS, and then increasing to approximately 97.2% at 9e8 TFLOPS. A solid, blue line denotes the loss ratio for SepLLM (n=128), beginning at approximately 98.1% at 1e7 TFLOPS, decreasing to approximately 97.1% at 3e8 TFLOPS, and reaching a peak of approximately 98.7% at 7e8 TFLOPS. A solid, green line represents the loss ratio for SepLLM (n=64, H), starting at approximately 98.4% at 1e7 TFLOPS, declining to approximately 97.6% at 3e8 TFLOPS, and reaching a value of approximately 98.3% at 9e8 TFLOPS. Finally, a solid, dark red line indicates the loss ratio for SepLLM (n=64, H/T), beginning at approximately 98.6% at 1e7 TFLOPS, decreasing to approximately 97.8% at 3e8 TFLOPS, and stabilizing at approximately 98.5% at 9e8 TFLOPS.
